description: Source code for a Git repository walker implementation, including functions for processing commits, trees, tags, and objects, as well as fetching objects and managing traversal state.

methods.name: walker_say
methods.description: Prints a message to stderr if verbose mode is enabled in the walker.

methods.name: report_missing
methods.description: Reports an error when an object cannot be obtained, including current commit context.

methods.name: process_tree
methods.description: Processes a tree object, recursively processing subtrees and blobs.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Processes a commit object, including its parents and associated tree.

methods.name: process_tag
methods.description: Processes a tag object, then its tagged object.

methods.name: process_object
methods.description: Dispatches processing based on object type (commit, tree, blob, tag).

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing function that manages object fetching and queuing.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main loop to process queued objects, fetch missing objects, and update progress.

methods.name: interpret_target
methods.description: Interprets a target string as an object ID or ref name.

methods.name: mark_complete
methods.description: Marks a reference as complete for traversal.

methods.name: walker_targets_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for target references.

methods.name: walker_fetch
methods.description: Fetches objects and updates refs based on targets.

methods.name: walker_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a walker.
